notes.title: 'Lore' Demo Releases Today
notes.notes:
Lore, the game Lore: The Hunt is based on, is releasing it's free demo today! Come check it out at 13:00PST. 

Check the game out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380190Lore

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38998473/0b76a6e0f07b6a2b5d9fbc78fa88e0a7e2692aea.png[/img]

It will feature the core gameplay loop, multiple locations to explore and puzzles to complete. It also features an early version of the enemy AI that will learn from your past encounters and change it's behavior to try to stop you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38998473/6b699b55889e01b42a1d50b3fa32c8dfe416ae5d.png[/img]

See you all in game!

notes.title: Switching The Format from 3 versus 1 to 4 versus 1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just a quick notice that the game is changing from a 3v1 to a 4v1 game after some internal balancing changes. I want to include more players to make up for the current strength of the Hunter. 

About a Early Access release date, there will be news on that this week, most likely. 

Hope to see you all in game soon!
- Max Schmid
